partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Cross-species and molecular-activity GOF consensus
results.hypothesis: A drug is a high-mechanism treatment candidate when it suppresses two distinct GOF disease genes through independent exact mouse-phenotype and molecular-activity branches.
results.body: drug decreases one GOF gene with exact mouse phenotype support and a distinct GOF gene enabling a compact decreased molecular activity
results.mechanism_rationale: Two independent directional branches converge on the disease through distinct genes, exact cross-species phenotype support, and a compact molecular function.
results.trapi_notes: The positive branches are TRAPI-expressible; repeated drug and disease identity, gene inequality, negative directional evidence, provenance, taxon, variant-form, degree, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (model_driver:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[gene_effect:AFFECTS]->(model_driver)
MATCH (model_driver)-[model_association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->
      (object:Disease)
MATCH (model_driver)-[:ORTHOLOGOUS_TO]-(mouse_gene:Gene)
      -[model_evidence:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(phenotype:PhenotypicFeature)
      <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
MATCH (subject)-[activity_effect:AFFECTS]->
      (activity:MolecularActivity)<-[:ENABLES]-(activity_driver:Gene)
MATCH (activity_driver)-[activity_association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object)
WHERE model_driver <> activity_driver
  AND gene_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND gene_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND gene_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND activity_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND activity_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(model_association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND model_association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(activity_association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND activity_association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND 'NCBITaxon:9606' IN coalesce(model_driver.in_taxon, [])
  AND 'NCBITaxon:10090' IN coalesce(mouse_gene.in_taxon, [])
  AND 'infores:mgi' IN
      coalesce(model_evidence.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:ctd' IN
      coalesce(activity_effect.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND activity._miner_gene_enable_degree <= 58
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[opposite:AFFECTS]->(model_driver)
    WHERE opposite.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
      AND opposite.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
      AND opposite.object_direction_qualifier = 'increased'
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
